requirement:
No prompt, tool result, or tool error the harness gives the model MUST state a
line number or line range of a project source, except within source text it
quotes and where a tool error repeats a line number the model supplied. The
harness MUST identify a source location by file and outline selector under
{cite}`requirements.references.outline_selectors` instead.
rationale:
## Obligations and coverage

`requirements.authoring.no_line_numbers` prohibits project-source line numbers and ranges in (1) prompts, (2) tool results, and (3) tool errors, except quoted source and tool errors repeating model-supplied numbers. It also requires source locations to use (4) files and (5) outline selectors under `requirements.references.outline_selectors`.

- **Prompts:** `src/inputs.rs#impl[InputSelector]/fn[to_model_input]` uses `to_input` to emit file, selector and hash, adding kind and quoted text rather than source positions. `src/sites.rs#impl[SiteItem]/fn[matches_value]` similarly emits query metadata and selectors, with quoted text for violations. `src/authoring/mod.rs#fn[initial_prompt]` incorporates these representations. Exact mandatory-input coverage is provided by `src/authoring/inputs.rs#mod[tests]/fn[anchored_files_contribute_root_node_inputs]`. The site-prompt path is checked by `src/authoring/mod.rs#mod[tests]/fn[site_reviews_use_their_prompt_and_record_applies_and_the_site]`; violation-match output is checked by `src/sites.rs#mod[tests]/fn[sites_are_the_innermost_nodes_of_site_matches_and_violations_within_them]`.
- **Tool results:** `src/authoring/tools.rs#fn[outline_entries]`, `src/authoring/tools.rs#fn[references]`, and `src/authoring/tools.rs#impl[SearchNodes]/fn[entries]` construct location-bearing results with selectors rather than numeric positions. `src/authoring/inputs.rs#impl[AssessmentSources]/fn[read_lines]` converts requested ranges into outline-node reads rather than exposing their positions. These paths are verified by the marked tests `outline_lists_nested_nodes_without_text_or_inputs`, `references_list_names_and_flattened_sites_without_recording_inputs`, `search_merges_context_windows_and_respects_ignore_rules`, `separate_windows_in_one_node_are_divided_by_an_elision_line`, `reading_records_only_delivered_sources_and_their_terms`, and `line_range_reads_record_the_innermost_covering_nodes`, all under `src/authoring/tools.rs#mod[tests]`. Their assertions check selector-bearing results and the absence of numeric location fields; quoted source remains available.
- **Tool errors:** `src/authoring/mod.rs#fn[converse]` routes dispatch failures through `src/authoring/line_numbers.rs#fn[without_source_lines]`. That function removes parser positions and replaces diagnostic source positions with file/root-selector locations. `read_lines` constructs invalid-range errors using only the requested numbers, including when the end was omitted. `src/authoring/line_numbers.rs#mod[tests]/fn[tool_errors_drop_the_source_line_of_a_parse_error]` checks parser, configuration, query and duplicate-declaration diagnostics, plus supplied single-number and range exceptions. `src/authoring/mod.rs#mod[tests]/fn[tool_errors_give_the_model_no_line_numbers_it_did_not_supply]` verifies actual conversation delivery strips an internally generated parser line number and checks that an omitted-end invalid request does not reveal the file length.

The file-and-selector obligations are covered by these same output assertions, including nested selectors, anonymous plain-text selectors and the empty root selector. The cited selector requirement is applied here rather than independently reassessed. No unmet obligation or unacknowledged gap was found.

text: No prompt, tool result, or tool error the harness gives the model MUST state a
line number or line range of a project source, except within source text it
quotes and where a tool error repeats a line number the model supplied. The
harness MUST identify a source location by file and outline selector under
An outline selector MUST be a `/`-separated path of segments from the file's
root node to an outline node; the empty selector MUST select the root node. A
named node's segment MUST be `kind[name]`. An anonymous node's segment MUST be
`kind@hash`, where `hash` is the first twelve hexadecimal digits of its identity
segments would otherwise be identical MUST be disambiguated by `#N`, their
one-based position among those siblings in source order, except `line` nodes:
identical lines are interchangeable, so a `line` selector MUST resolve when any
line with that content exists in the file. In names, `%`, `[`, `]`, `/`, `#`,
`@`, and whitespace MUST be percent-encoded as UTF-8 bytes, so selectors are
reversible. Line numbers MUST NOT form part of a selector.
